item.title: South Carolina Women Kick Off Support For Women’s Suffrage Monument in Washington, D.C.

item.title: Palmetto Community Care launches TelePrEP, offering virtual access to HIV prevention for adults across the Tri-County

item.title: The Art and Science of Designing Walk-Through Dinosaur Parks
item.description: Walk-through dinosaur parks have become increasingly popular as families, schools, and tourists seek immersive experiences that combine entertainment with learning. Unlike traditional displays, these parks invite visitors to move through carefully designed environments that recreate prehistoric landscapes, encouraging exploration and curiosity at every step. However, creating an experience that feels believable, engaging, and educational presents a unique design challenge.
